item.title: [7] Imaging of nanoscale polar textures in quantum paraelectric SrTiO3
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Robert Hovden, Ismail El Baggari

Authors: Yang Zhang, Suk Hyun Sung, Nishkarsh Agarwal, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Experimental imaging of polar nanodomains in a key quantum material, SrTiO3.

Tags: #material #SrTiO3 #phase-transition

Abstract: Cryo-STEM reveals that SrTiO3 forms periodic polar nanodomains below 105 K, but these fragment below 40 K, linking quantum paraelectricity to nanoscale polar ordering and disordering.

item.title: [8] Semiconducting and magnetic lanthanide MXenes from intercalated halides
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Zhifang Chai, Qing Huang

Authors: Qian Fang, Liming Wang, Kai Chang, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Synthesis of a new class of 2D magnetic semiconducting materials, highly relevant for spintronics.

Tags: #material #2D-materials #magnetism

Abstract: A bottom-up synthesis strategy creates lanthanide MXenes (Ln2CT2) that combine semiconducting behaviour with ferromagnetism, offering a promising new class of two-dimensional materials for spintronic applications.
